issues: Cards and background were grey placeholder blocks and damage numbers like +1.2k meant nothing, so the combo said nothing about feature value
The three cards sat in a thin band mid-frame with empty grey above and below; the counter was a small black chip in the corner
Grey, indigo and orange read flat; there was no game-style punch at all
Impacts were just one outline ring, and the third hit felt about as strong as the first
changes: Custom cobalt arcade look: a saturated cobalt colour field, white cards and arcade yellow, borrowing fighting-game combo UI (yellow italic 900 weight with comic hard shadows)

Content is three updates of a fictional build tool, Brickyard 3.0; each damage number is time saved per push (−48s / −3 min / −12 min) and settles into the card footer, ending on Up to 16 min back on every push.
480×330 cards with 48px titles; dashed slots with big 01/02/03 set up the expectation; the counter is a 140→196px italic ×N with a three-segment heat bar

Global hitstop is kept and easier to feel: the scrolling background stripes, cards and effects all run on one remapped clock, so the whole frame freezes 2f per hit; only the flash and slot glow use real frames

Each hit escalates: damage text 88/104/124px, 10/13/16 sparks, a wider shock ring, counter pulse 1.3/1.45/1.6 and tilt −2/−4/−6°; damage numbers now pop on the card face and rise, so they never collide with the counter
Rhythm: an even 28f combo beat, the closing line rising word by word 14f after the last hit, then a ~2.4s poster hold; 176f total
